steps.step: Real workforce session established in the Admin Web browser
steps.detail: Signed in as admin@monienaija.local through the normal login form (POST /api/v1/internal/a2/workforce/local-admin-sessions). Staff MFA assurance gates the compliance workspace, so the operator authenticates for real rather than receiving a planted token. Navigation rendered 33 sections.

steps.step: Synthetic Tier 1 customer registered through the supported staff workflow
steps.detail: The Admin Web registration wizard created the customer via POST /api/v1/customers (HTTP 201). Customer id 7355f1bc-bbf8-48f2-bfff-c50f09bda675, reference mn-cus-6fe6e054c1201a7dabead8ed. No SQL inserted this customer.

steps.step: Primary phone verified through the real registration OTP flow
steps.detail: "Send phone OTP" called POST /api/v1/customers/registration/otp; the server persisted a salted hash of the code (kyc_registration_otps) and delivered the message through the notification provider. The code was read from that delivery boundary as the handset would (JOURNEY_RECORD_SMS), not from the database.
POST /api/v1/customers/registration/otp/verify returned HTTP 200. The primary phone is now verified for this customer.

steps.step: BVN identity document recorded by the operator through the Admin Web
steps.detail: The wizard saved the document via POST /api/v1/customers/7355f1bc-bbf8-48f2-bfff-c50f09bda675/identity-document (HTTP 201). This is the identifier the provider will corroborate; it creates no consent row, no verification attempt and no verified claim, so it is not identity evidence.

steps.step: Registration workflow completed, customer left as an unverified DRAFT
steps.detail: Profile, contact and residential address were each saved through the wizard. The customer is a DRAFT with a verified primary phone and no KYC assessment, so the registration review must still refuse activation until identity is verified.

steps.step: Tier 1 default customer class assigned by registration
steps.detail: registration-review reports defaults.customerClass = {"configured":true,"classCode":"STANDARD","className":"Standard","source":"REGISTRATION_DEFAULT","effectiveFrom":"2026-11-26T19:09:01.073Z"} and trustedEvidence.state = MISSING. The class comes from the approved LEVEL_1 tier-default mapping, not a per-customer override.

trustedEvidence.detail: No trusted, identity-bound identity evidence is on record

steps.step: Compliance operator signed in for the identity decision
steps.detail: Signed in as compliance@monienaija.local through the same login form. Separation of duties is preserved: KYC identity verification requires the COMPLIANCE role, and the operator who registered the customer is not the operator who verifies identity.

steps.step: Customer consent notice served to the operator, and approval correctly refused
steps.detail: GET /api/v1/internal/kyc/review-workspace/customers/7355f1bc-bbf8-48f2-bfff-c50f09bda675 returned consentNotice version v1.0-ng ("I authorise MonieNaija to verify my BVN with the licensed identity provider for Tier 1 KYC, and I understand the result …"). supportedDecisions.approvalEligibleNow = false: KYC approval cannot be recorded before the provider verifies identity.

consentNotice.text: I authorise MonieNaija to verify my BVN with the licensed identity provider for Tier 1 KYC, and I understand the result is stored as identity evidence.

supportedDecisions.approvalBlockedReason: Trusted verification evidence reader is unavailable for this customer.

steps.step: Customer consent captured and identity verified through the governed request
steps.detail: POST verify-identity answered HTTP 200 with status MATCH from provider PREMBLY (route v1). The request carried customerConsentConfirmed=true and noticeVersion v1.0-ng. The server created consent b0ca6c13-afed-427c-877b-12d344b11804 and verification attempt c7b6fbd2-e5dd-4198-9682-5356e37bb29d; the consent row is the link between the customer's attestation and this provider attempt. Nothing was seeded: evidenceStatus.consents was [] before this call.

steps.step: Consent is linked to the verification attempt and the verified claim
steps.detail: The dossier now reports consents=1, verificationAttempts=1, identityClaims=1, readerStatus=READY. The consent id carried by the attempt equals b0ca6c13-afed-427c-877b-12d344b11804, which is the consent returned by the verification call.

steps.step: Tier 1 KYC approved, tier-default class re-assigned
steps.detail: POST /api/v1/customers/7355f1bc-bbf8-48f2-bfff-c50f09bda675/kyc-assessment returned HTTP 201. Approval performs a TIER_DEFAULT class re-assignment; that write is the path PR #41 corrected, and it no longer raises. Response: {"id":"db6a1ad3-bc4f-4d4f-afac-17495da73795","customerId":"7355f1bc-bbf8-48f2-bfff-c50f09bda675","level":"LEVEL_1","status":"APPROVED"}

steps.step: Tier 1 verified state, ready to claim, with no wallet or credential
steps.detail: After approval the registration review reports verifiedTier=LEVEL_1, customerClass=STANDARD, trustedEvidence.state=VERIFIED, activatable=true, wallet=null, outstanding=["account_active","wallet"]. The record is fully verified and still unclaimed: no wallet exists and no customer credential has been issued.
